footer_blurb: Protein records, structures, sequences and experimental data.
print_error: This record could not be prepared for printing.
print_not_found: There is no printable record at this address.
my_intro: Your submissions, reviews and local drafts, all in one place.
my_needs_action_empty: Nothing needs your attention right now.
my_submissions_empty: You have not submitted anything yet. When you are ready, start with the submission wizard.
my_wiki_empty: You have not annotated any record yet. If you see something worth adding, write a note.
my_append_only_note: File a correction to change a record, or add a revision to update a validation.
my_filter_placeholder: Filter by title or public id
my_imports_server_note: These records came from batch imports and stay available on any browser.
my_local_only_note: The items below live in this browser.
my_local_empty: This browser is still empty. Drafts, saved items and recent views will show up here.
import_not_submission: Batch imports live under My imports
nav_search_placeholder: Protein name, gene, organism, spd: id…
page_find_hint: Enter next · Shift+Enter previous · Esc close
home_subtitle: Want to get to know a protein? Search for it to see its predicted folds, mutant sequences and wet-lab evidence. Then drag the pH, temperature and salt sliders to see how it behaves in different environments.
home_try_label: Not sure where to start? Try:
home_step1_body: Search by name, gene or organism to open the protein page.
home_step2_body: Each protein lists every submitted fold and model, with mutant sequences and confidence scores you can open in 3D.
home_step3_body: The explorer on every protein page filters folds by pH, temperature and ionic strength — see which mutants hold up.
home_api_note: The data service is unreachable right now
home_two_tiers_body: Weight comes from wet-lab data that passed peer review. Computation submissions go public after schema validation and are marked unverified.
search_term_too_long: Search terms are limited to 48 bytes (about 16 CJK characters). Shorten it and try again.
search_no_results: No matches. Proteins live under their display name — try a shorter keyword, or pick a type filter that matches what you expect.
search_hint: Search protein names, genes, organisms, plasmids, cell lines and record ids.
search_where_hint: Search reads names and record content, and every result opens its own page. Protein pages also carry fold records, mutants and 3D structures.
query_source_hint: A protein root may carry a UniProt accession (imported on demand); leave blank to infer it from the id shape.
ext_section_hint: Results from UniProt, PDB, NCBI and other external catalogs appear alongside local results. Import one and it becomes a local record.
ext_import_failed_hint: That import did not go through. You can try again.
ext_unavailable: External sources are unreachable right now.
ext_already_local_hint: If the same record already exists here, the import reuses it.
wiki_absent_cta: No wiki entry for this record yet.
wiki_absent_readonly: No wiki entry for this record.
wiki_required_fields: Title, body and change summary are required.
refs_required: Source and external id are required.
artifact_bytes_note: Downloads keep the filename they were stored with.
codon_hint_source: A name a reviewer can cite, e.g. “Kazusa · E. coli K-12 (RSCU)”
design_assemble_note: Assembly runs in SPICE; the submission is recorded here.
design_no_vectors: No vectors yet — design one first
design_no_cassettes: No cassettes yet — design one first
design_site_none: This vector has no declared insertion site; the assembler will choose one.
design_assemble_done: Linked. The vector–cassette pairing is recorded; assembly runs in SPICE.
design_intro: Define vectors & cassettes, then record assemblies
fold_artifacts_immutable: You can attach new files; existing attachments stay as they are.
fold_artifacts_append_hint: Attach later outputs such as trajectories or a final structure. The fold creator or an admin can append.
fold_hint_artifact_id: the structure file — choose one of your uploads, or upload it right here
fold_hint_other_fold: the binding partner — search and pick the other fold
fold_hint_prediction: Usually you load the JSON a SPICE run exported. You can also fill rows; coordinates takes [[x,y,z],…].
fold_hint_supersedes: a previous assessment version of this fold
fold_wizard_intro: The whole chain in one pass: protein → sequence → fold. Already have a sequence? Submit just the fold.
fold_pick_protein: Search for the protein this sequence belongs to.
form_hint_multi_pick: Pick from your uploads — or add a file just below.
form_hint_json_object: key/value rows — dotted keys (a.b) nest, numbers and true/false are detected automatically
me_already_researcher: You already have the researcher role
me_hint_sequence: the sequence these effects describe — search and pick it
me_length_mismatch: positions / from / to must have equal length
me_roles_note: Roles are granted by admins; apply for researcher below
measurement_hint_sequence: the sequence this number describes — search and pick it
measurement_hint_construct: optional — the construct the measurement was made in
ms_hint_mutations: one card per mutation: position, from, to
org_claim_intro: Claim an organization with a verified institutional email
org_claim_submitted: Claim submitted; an admin will follow up by email
org_hint_evidence: Domain or identity verification material as JSON
org_login_for_memberships: Sign in to see your organizations
org_remove_confirm: Remove this member from the organization?
org_researchers_private: The organization leader can see the full roster.
pathway_diagram_hint: Auto-laid out; zoom in to read, click a node for entity or reaction details.
pathway_steps_from_topology: Topology steps come from the import. To add or change one, register a reaction step above.
pathway_diagram_empty: This pathway has no topology diagram yet. Import a Reactome pathway or submit your own topology and it will appear here.
protocol_hint_reagents: one card per reagent: name, amount, unit
protocol_hint_steps: one card per step: order + description (or use + extra field)
protocol_publication_rule: A protocol becomes published after 2 distinct researchers approve the same revision
protocol_publish_note: Published = approved by two distinct researchers on the same revision
protocol_review_login: Sign in with a researcher role to review
recipe_hint_composition: one card per component: name, amount, unit
refs_only_id_hint: Just the DOI or PubMed id — title, authors, year and the open-access link are fetched from CrossRef/PubMed.
refs_shape_hint: This doesn't look like a DOI (10.xxxx/…) or a numeric PMID yet — the lookup may come back empty.
refs_other_manual: This source has no registry to look up against — fill in the details.
refs_unresolved_hint: You can still attach it — add the title and year yourself if you have them.
revision_intro: Revise this report — edit what you measured and say what changed. It goes back for screening.
revision_change_summary_hint: One line the reviewers and curators will read.
schema_intro: JSON schemas published by the backend; each endpoint validates with its own rules.
sequence_hint_parent: the parent this sequence derives from — search and pick it
submit_intro: Protein records, sequences, folds and experimental data.
submit_researcher_needed: Submitting and editing require the researcher role; apply from your account page. Browsing and export are open to everyone.
submit_then_fold: Create records in order: sequence → environment → model → fold
submit_wetlab_body: Start a wet-lab validation from any fold page
supplier_hint_leader: Suppliers are listed under an organization you lead; eligible organizations are detected automatically
supplier_org_failed: Could not load your organizations. Try again.
supplier_org_none: Create or claim an organization first.
upload_note: The file is attached to this record once the upload finishes.
validation_hint_observations: one object per observed residue pair / metric
validation_hint_target_sequence: the sequence this measurement validates — search and pick it
validation_intro: Wet-lab validations are screened by a curator, then open for community review
upload_cc_notice: Uploads are published under CC licenses and cannot be edited after submission.
admin_token_tier_intro: Graph-query metering entitlement (§41). Owners read the token id from their own account page; minting is always `standard`, this grants `unlimited`.
login_failed_hint: The sign-in session was not established. Please sign in again.
pdb_hint_method: from the source vocabulary, e.g. X-ray diffraction
pdb_intro: Experimental structure entries with method, resolution, chains and BinaryCIF coordinates; open an entry to inspect it in Mol*.
pdb_no_coords_note: This page stores PDB metadata; coordinates live on the linked protein page.
pdb_upsert_hint: The PDB id identifies the record; re-importing updates metadata and the source update time.
prov_bad_json: content must be valid JSON for application/json
prov_intro: Raw data snapshots referenced by this record.
query_anon_hint: Anonymous tier allows depth 2 / 20 resolutions; a session or standard token raises it, unlimited goes to depth 10 / 2000.
query_token_title: Run with your own API token
query_token_hint: Paste a token to run queries with its owner's identity and tier. The token is saved in this browser and page scripts can read it; clear it after use on a shared machine.
query_token_active: A token is set — queries will run under its tier.
query_intro: Walk connected records in one call — pick a starting record, add expansions, run. The result tree is the same data the record pages show, just composed.
query_roots_hint: A batch holds up to 25 starting records and shares one read budget. Fields go comma separated; limit caps each list edge of that node.
submit_then_sequence: Create the sequence, then submit its fold
token_intro: Self-issued credentials for scripts, CI importers and the MCP façade. A token uses your live roles and stops working when they are revoked.
token_login: Sign in to mint and manage API tokens
token_minted_once: Copy it now. The secret is shown once.
token_revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Scripts using it will stop working immediately.
issue_intro: Corrections and retraction requests are stored as community records pending review.
env_explorer_title: How does it fold in your conditions?
env_explorer_intro: Load this protein's structure records once, then drag pH, temperature and salt to filter — every row links to its 3D fold, and the table shows which mutants were modeled.
env_explorer_env_partial: {n} environment(s) could not be resolved; their folds stay hidden.
env_explorer_empty: No folds inside the selected ranges.
env_explorer_none: This protein has no fold records yet.
settings_intro: These preferences apply to this browser.
settings_full_ids_hint: Tables and chips shorten long ids (fold:1234abcd…); switch this on to see every id whole.
settings_account_hint: Profile, roles, organizations and sign-out live on your account pages.
settings_account_signed_out_hint: Sign in to manage your profile, roles and organizations.
settings_graph_hint: Graph-builder API tokens are managed on the graph page and saved in this browser.
settings_license_hint: The SPD frontend source is Apache 2.0. Data imported from external sources keeps each source's own terms.
license_intro: SPD is open source. The frontend source is Apache 2.0; the biological records keep the terms of the sources they came from.
license_code_body: You can use, modify and redistribute the SPD frontend, including commercially. Distributions must keep the license text and any attribution notices. Apache 2.0 also grants an express patent license. It does not grant rights to the SPD name or logo.
license_data_body: SPD brings together protein, sequence, structure, enzyme, pathway, reagent, cell-line and literature records from public databases and community submissions. These records are not covered by the frontend's Apache 2.0 license. Rights remain with the original source or contributor, and that source's terms apply. Record pages show the source and any license the source provides; check those terms before reusing a record.
license_third_party_body: The frontend bundles open-source libraries such as Svelte, Tailwind CSS and Mol*. Each keeps its own license; nothing on this page changes those terms. Exact versions are pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml, and license texts ship with the packages.
license_attribution_body: If you build on the SPD frontend, link back to the source repository. For scientific reuse, cite the original data source shown on the record, not only SPD.
license_questions: Licensing questions are welcome in the issue tracker.
browse_intro: Browse everything by category. If you already have a protein in mind, the search box at the top is faster.
browse_desc_science: Start here to find a protein's folds, mutation effects and structure comparisons.
browse_desc_design: Vectors, cassettes, constructs and BioBricks for building experiments.
browse_desc_catalogs: The wet-lab shelf: enzymes, strains, cell lines, media and condition templates.
browse_desc_community: Who contributed what, corrections, retractions, benchmarks and collection stats.
browse_desc_reference: Experimentally determined structures catalogued from the external PDB.
browse_desc_tools: For programmatic access: the graph query DSL, API tokens and schemas. Everyday browsing does not need them.
help_title: Four ideas to get you started
help_intro: Start with four core record types; the rest of the catalog builds around them.
help_c1_body: The thing itself: name, gene, organism. A protein page is the hub — open it to see every fold, sequence and validation attached to it.
help_c2_body: A string of amino acids — the wild type or any mutant. Mutations are recorded as lists (e.g. A45G), so you can search what variants exist for a protein.
help_c3_body: One structure prediction: which model computed it, for which sequence, under which environment (pH, temperature, salt) and how confident it is. Opens in a 3D viewer.
help_c4_body: Wet-lab validation for a fold. It counts toward weight after two independent curators screen it.
help_flow_hint: Protein → sequences (mutants) → folds (per model & environment) → validations (wet-lab truth checks).
help_search_body: Search reads names, genes, organisms and record ids — exact ids are optional. A protein hit opens its page directly; the type filter narrows to plasmids, cell lines or community records.
help_contribute_title: Want to add your own data?
help_contribute_body: Sign in with ORCID and start from the submission wizard: sequences, folds and wet-lab validations all work. Uploads are published under CC licenses; if you need a correction, file one from the record page.
help_steps_link: Or start from the three-step cards on the home page
query_reject_depth_signed: This expansion exceeds your tier's depth limit. Remove a level or use an unlimited token.
query_reject_depth_anon: Anonymous queries expand one level; sign in to reach three.
query_reject_budget: The read budget is too small; trim the expansion and try again.
query_needs_ids: Fill in a record id for every starting record.
query_field_limit_hint: caps this node's list-edge children (default 20, max 100)
query_leaf_note: Leaf node — no edges to expand.
query_depth_warning: Past level {max} for your current tier.
sequence_hint_mutation_lines: One substitution per line, e.g. A45G — wild-type letter, position, mutant letter.
sequence_mutation_bad_token: That mutation format is not recognized; use a form like A45G.
submit_validation_desc: Report what the bench measured against a predicted fold — screened, then community-reviewed.
submit_species_data_desc: Contribute your own measurements for one organism — Km, kcat, optima — beside the imported records.
submit_species_data_intro: Record what you actually measured in an organism and show it as a community contribution with your citation.
species_data_enzyme_hint: Search by name or EC number. The entry attaches to this enzyme's EC number and appears for every record that shares it.
species_data_citation_hint: Paper, DOI or lab notebook reference for these values.
species_data_units_hint: Write units into each value, e.g. 0.42 mM, 18 s⁻¹, 7.4, 37 °C. Leave fields you did not measure empty.
species_data_need_field: Fill in at least one measured field.
species_data_attribution_note: Your citation stays visible on the entry.
submit_validation_intro: Describe how an experiment tested a predicted structure. Fill in the normal fields; the page assembles the JSON.
validation_placeholder_foldid: spd:predicted_fold:… (open a fold page and copy its id)
validation_find_fold: No id handy? Search for the protein, open one of its folds, and copy the fold id.
validation_after_note: Accepted validations grow your factor on the wet-lab lead board:
validation_hint_assay_method: e.g. DSF, circular dichroism, cryo-EM, western blot, activity assay
validation_hint_obs_lines: One per line: method | result | units — e.g. DSF | Tm = 58.2 | °C
validation_obs_bad_line: Each observation line needs at least “method | result”
validation_adv_json_error: The advanced JSON is invalid; fix it or clear the field.
lb_intro: Ranked by contribution factor, counting wet-lab work that passed independent review.
lb_empty: No wet-lab validation has been accepted yet. Be the first:
lb_method: Factor = ledger weights of accepted contributions. Validations need at least two independent published reviews.
validations_intro: Experimental reports testing predicted folds — each screened by a curator, then opened for peer review.
validations_empty: No validations yet — the bench speaks first.
fold_attach_file: Attach data files (BinaryCIF structures — .cif text converts automatically, trajectories, distograms…)
validation_upload_data: Attach assay data files (raw data, gels, spectra…)
upload_none_mine: You have no uploads yet — add one below.
upload_none_matching: This field accepts different file types — upload one below.
upload_load_failed: Could not load your uploads; anything already selected is still here.
upload_signin_hint: Sign in to pick from your uploads.
submit_protein_desc: A protein that exists in the world: name, gene, organism — every other record hangs off it.
submit_sequence_desc: One concrete amino-acid sequence: the reference, or a mutation of it.
submit_fold_desc: A predicted structure with its environment and model — create the protein and sequence inline, or attach to existing records.
submit_design_desc: Vector, cassette or construct blueprints — the parts you assemble in the lab.
submit_codon_desc: How often each codon is used by one organism. Paste or upload the table; the content fingerprint is generated automatically.
submit_organization_desc: Claim an organization so its members can publish under one roof.
submit_browse_only_note: Vector, cassette, construct and fold-dependent records come from the wizard above. Corrections and retractions start on the record page.
submit_enzymes_desc: Biocatalysts with EC number, class and optimal conditions.
submit_reactions_desc: What an enzyme converts: substrates, products, cofactors, reversibility.
submit_pathways_desc: A named chain of reactions, e.g. glycolysis. Members can be linked later.
submit_reagents_desc: Kits, chemicals and consumables, with catalog identifiers.
submit_strains_desc: Living host strains: species, genotype, resistance markers.
submit_cell_lines_desc: Cell lines with species and passage notes.
submit_media_recipes_desc: Culture media: what goes in and how to make it.
submit_condition_templates_desc: Reusable environment presets — pH, temperature, ionic strength.
submit_protocols_desc: Step-by-step bench procedures, versioned like a wiki page.
submit_biobricks_desc: Standardized DNA parts with their registry identifiers.
submit_restriction_enzymes_desc: Recognition sites and cut positions. The whole table exports as one bundle.
submit_measurements_desc: A raw measured value (absorbance, yield, Tm…) tied to a record.
submit_families_desc: A group of sequences or proteins you declare homologous.
submit_mutation_sets_desc: A named batch of mutations, e.g. a scanning library.
submit_contributions_desc: Who did what on which record.
submit_corrections_desc: Say a published record is wrong. Usually filed from the record page.
submit_retractions_desc: Formally retract a record with a reason. Usually filed from the record page.
submit_model_feedback_desc: Where a model went wrong — failure cases steer the next version.
submit_kind_intro: Fill in the fields and submit; the page checks the format.
submit_hint_target_id: the target record’s business id — e.g. spd:protein:8e31… (it is in the record’s URL)
target_picker_label: Which record is this statement about?
target_picker_placeholder: name, gene, organism… any clue you remember
target_picker_required: Pick the record this statement talks about first.
target_picker_no_results: No matches. The target needs to be published.
org_dir_intro: Verified organizations appear here. Click one for its profile page — leaders manage members from there.
org_dir_empty: No organizations yet. Claim yours and it will appear here once staff verify it.
org_profile_editor_hint: Each row is one profile field. Delete a row to remove that field from the public profile; nested values are stored as JSON text.
design_hint_format: internal name of the vector format
design_hint_license: how this design may be reused — CC-BY-4.0 unless you own everything in it
design_hint_features: one card per feature; start/end/strand are numbers
design_hint_sites: one card per site; position is a number
design_hint_artifact: the sequence file — choose one of your uploads (optional)
design_hint_provenance: advanced provenance object; the license selector above usually suffices
design_hint_parts: one card per part; id and role are required
design_hint_order: part ids, comma-separated, in assembly order
design_raw_override: Advanced: submit a whole JSON document instead (e.g. exported from a design tool)
codon_bar_hint: One row per codon; the number is the usage value in this species snapshot.
codon_no_map: This snapshot has no usable codon map.
codon_code_hint: One genetic-code table can be shared by many species; the usage frequencies are a separate assertion.
admin_portal_hint: The editorial office, decision inboxes and the audit trail in one place.
admin_app_actions_hint: Approve / reject needs the institution email confirmed first (email received).
admin_applications_hint: Undecided applications first; approved applicants get the researcher role automatically.
admin_claims_hint: Approving activates the organization and makes the applicant its leader.
org_claim_next_hint: Your claim enters the editorial queue. Once approved, the organization is activated and you become its owner; we will email you either way.
protein_overview_hint: Sequences, structures, wet-lab evidence and community ledger live in the tabs above.
protein_preview_pick: Pick a fold on the left to render its coordinates.
protein_observed_none: No exact-match PDB structure is bound to this sequence yet. Importing a PDB entry binds it automatically.
protein_evidence_hint: Wet-lab validations and observed structures behind this protein's folds (walked the first {n} folds).
protein_evidence_none: These folds have no wet-lab validation yet.
protein_related_hint: Interactions and comparisons bind fold records of this protein.
protein_related_needs_login: Sign in to see related records.
protein_ledger_none: No contributions, corrections or retractions reference this protein yet.
market_intro: Keep parts, vectors, constructs and proteins you want to revisit in a local basket saved in this browser.
market_empty: Your market is empty. Add items from a record page or the discovery list below.
market_no_saved: Nothing saved yet. Have a look around the catalogs.
market_discover_hint: Pick records from the public catalogs; saved items stay in this browser.
market_discover_empty: Nothing in this catalog can be added right now.
import_intro: Create many records from CSV / TSV / JSON in one pass. The browser parses the file and the server writes each row.
import_no_rows: No importable rows found. Want to check the file format?
import_local_only: Parsing happens in your browser; the server validates each write.
import_template_json_hint: The template column must be a JSON object
import_excluded_vectors: Vector templates are not available for batch import yet.
import_excluded_cassettes: Expression cassettes are not available for batch import yet.
import_choose_file: Choose a CSV / TSV / JSON file
import_sequential: Rows are submitted one at a time; a failed row does not stop the rest.
import_paste_hint: First row is the header; comma, tab and quoted fields are supported.
vector_seq_none: This template has no sequence file; the map is drawn from feature ranges.
vector_seq_failed: Could not read the sequence artifact.
vector_map_hint: Arcs are features colored by type; ticks mark insertion sites. Click an arc for its full record.
vector_no_coords: Features without coordinates are listed below but not drawn on the map.
biobrick_no_params: No quantitative parameters recorded for this part.
biobrick_no_vectors: No vector template links this part yet.
biobrick_registry_usage_hint: Usage count comes from the source registry.
submit_browse_only: These records come from other workflows.
dvCopiedImageToast: Copied the high-resolution selection map to the clipboard as an image!
pmCircularCanvasNotReady: Circular map canvas is not ready yet
pmLinearCanvasNotReady: Linear map canvas is not ready yet
pmLinearizeBody: Cut at bp {v1} and reassembled as a linear sequence
tkCopyPng: Copy Selection as High-Res PNG Image
reviews_intro: Wet-lab validations and protocols enter the public record after review. Institutional pools receive review assignments; reviews are completed on the record page.
reviews_no_seats: You hold no peer seats yet — ask your organization's leader to nominate you into their peer pool.
reviews_invited_hint: Invitation pending: click the accept link in the email we sent you.
reviews_no_tasks: Nothing on your plate right now.
reviews_target_note: Every reviewable record dispatches {n} pool reviewers; you are one of them.
peers_nominate_hint: The nominee gets a one-time accept link; the seat activates once they accept. They need an approved researcher application.
peers_empty: No pending invitations and no active seats yet.
peers_not_leader: The organization leader manages the peer pool.
dispatch_quota_hint: 0 means the obligation is met. Deleting the row returns it to unset. Quota progress updates live.
dispatch_shortfall_note: Records with fewer than {n} assignments come from an undersized review pool; each assignment shows its live completion state.
issue_correction_hint: Describe what is wrong, then add the field corrections as key/value rows.
issue_retraction_hint: Say why the record should be withdrawn; paste a link if there is public evidence.
submit_codon_usage_desc: Per-codon usage tables that codon-optimization tools read.
submit_genetic_codes_desc: NCBI genetic-code tables: one codon-to-amino-acid table shared by many species, which reference it through a binding.
codon_hint_title: For a multi-species dataset, a title helps, e.g. “Human and yeast CDS codon usage”
codon_hint_scientific_name: Optional; shown on the detail page. The tax id remains the key.
codon_mode_hint_single: One table belongs to one species; the genetic code follows its species binding.
codon_mode_hint_multi: One dataset may hold several species, each with its own usage values and genetic code.
codon_hint_code: Leave empty to choose from the species binding.
codon_multi_hint: Each row is one species; usage frequencies and the genetic code are recorded separately.
codon_multi_taxon_invalid: Row {n} needs a positive NCBI tax id.
codon_multi_duplicate: Tax id {n} appears twice in the dataset.
codon_multi_map_empty: Row {n} has no parsed codons yet.
codon_hint_taxon: Optional but recommended — type a scientific name and Resolve fills the NCBI taxid (e.g. 83333 for Escherichia coli K-12).
codon_hint_mode: Choose the reading the source actually uses; the totals are checked below.
cmx_relative_frequency: Share of each codon within its own amino acid — every complete row should add up to about 1.
cmx_rscu: Relative synonymous codon usage — a complete row adds up to about the number of codons for that amino acid.
cmx_optimal_set: Preferred codons are marked; values are weights.
cmx_other: Any other published reading; explain it in the table name and source.
codon_hint_source_url: Where the table came from, e.g. the Kazusa page for this organism
codon_paste_hint: Paste the rows, or load a CSV / TSV / TXT / JSON file. Layouts are all welcome: “GCT 0.05”, “Ala GCT 0.05 GCC 0.30 …”, “GCT,0.05”, “GCT=5%”, or a JSON object.
codon_sum_off: {n} complete rows do not add up to about {expect} for this reading:
codon_dups: {n} codons appeared twice; the later value was kept:
codon_unknown: Not in the standard genetic code; kept: {list}
codon_json_bad: That JSON could not be read as a codon table.
codon_bad_lines: {n} lines have a number but no recognizable codon
codon_bad_lines_note: Fix or delete these lines so you do not lose codons you meant to keep.
codon_partial: {n} amino acids still have no codon. Partial tables are fine; note it in the table name.
codon_no_codons: No codons parsed yet. Paste at least one row like “GCT 0.05”.
codon_sha_note: The content fingerprint is generated automatically and returned with the receipt.
codon_resolve_hint: Not sure whether this table exists? Look it up first.
codon_resolve_none: No snapshot for that source and taxid yet.
codon_rna_note: {n} codons use RNA spelling (U). The total check groups them with their DNA form; the table keeps your spelling.
issue_signin_cta: Sign in to correct or annotate
issue_write_researcher_only: Researchers can edit or annotate records; everyone can read and export data.
issue_confirm_label: Type the word retract to confirm
issue_append_only_note: Your statement enters the editorial queue as a new record.
revision_responses_intro: Answer each open reviewer remark by its number. Your replies are filed with the revision.
revision_response_placeholder: What you changed, or why you disagree — evidence welcome
revision_responses_missing: Answer every open reviewer remark before submitting the revision.
my_in_review_empty: Nothing of yours is waiting on curators, reviewers, or the editorial office.
my_in_review_note: These wait on reviewers or the editorial office; no action needed for now.
form_field_int_list: use whole numbers separated by commas
help_fix_title: How do I change a record?
help_fix_body: The record page has four actions: revise, file a correction, write a note, or request retraction. Everything you submit and its status lives in My workspace.
submit_hint_target_pick: Search by name or id and pick the record.
upload_bincif_needed: Structure files are stored as BinaryCIF: upload .bcif directly, or .cif text and it converts automatically.
my_files_note: Downloads keep the filename they were stored with.
organism_unresolved_hint: NCBI matched nothing — you can still type both boxes yourself.
organism_hint_pair: one half is enough — NCBI fills the name/taxid pair.
ci_hint: Each row asserts one field: pick it, the current value fills in, then enter what it should become. A blank proposed value asks for empty; choose “Other field” when the key is not listed.
ci_fields_loading: Reading the fields this record allows…
form_correction_items: A correction must assert at least one field with a proposed value.
admin_filings_hint: Corrections, retractions and contributions can be edited or withdrawn from public view. Withdrawn items are hidden from public views; the row and its audit remain and can be restored.
admin_filing_task_hint: Corrections and retractions target existing records: edit the wording or withdraw the filing.
admin_hide_hint: Withdrawing hides the filing from public lists, detail pages, search and feeds. The row and its reason remain in the audit and can be restored.
admin_restore_hint: Restoring makes the filing public again; the operation history is kept.
admin_audit_reason_ph: Why is this change being made?
moderate_dialog_hint: The reason is stored with the action and shown beside the review.
admin_review_edit_hint: You can edit the text of a review; the verdict and status stay unchanged. The reason is recorded.
ed_letter_public: The conclusion is public; the letter goes to the author.
ed_round_closed_note: This round is closed by its decision; late reviews are rejected.
ed_nudge_hint: The acceptance threshold is met; the editorial office needs to record a decision.
ed_decide_hint: This closes round {n}. Reviews already in stay public.
ed_accept_needs_two: Accepting needs at least 2 distinct published reviews this round; {n} so far.
ed_letter_title: Decision letter (the author receives exactly this)
ed_roster_hint: Reviewers invited for round {n}; declines and deadlines are recorded.
ed_roster_empty: No reviewers dispatched for this round yet.
ed_message_placeholder: Write to the desk and author…
ed_sub_awaiting_empty: No rounds are waiting for a decision.
review_confidential_hint: Only the editorial desk can read this.
dispatch_due_hint: The reviewer is reminded near the deadline and the ask expires on it.
dispatch_round_hint: Round-scoped: a reviewer declined or expired in one round can be asked again in a later round.
reviews_decline_hint: Declined for this round; a later round may invite you again.
reviews_declined: Request declined — the desk has been notified.
admin_roster_hint: Per-reviewer performance across rounds (bounded recent window).
features_none: No features have been recorded for this protein yet.
features_no_sequence: There is no sequence on file to anchor features yet.
features_unplaced: {n} feature(s) have no coordinates and are listed below.
features_click_hint: Click a row to select the range in the viewer.
keywords_wizard_hint: One card per keyword; leave the id empty to omit it
source_entry_status_hint: How the source (e.g. UniProt) reviews the entry.
crc64_wizard_hint: 16 uppercase hex digits quoted from the source
lineage_wizard_hint: JSON array of rank/value objects, copied from the source
pdb_entities_none: This entry has no entity data yet.
pdb_chain_verbatim: Sequence stored verbatim from the source, (MSE) and X included; the viewer draws the recognized residues.
admin_apply_hint: Accepting updates the target record from the assertions through the same validation as a submission. Sequence bytes, annotations, predicted evidence, entity sets and source version stamps are outside this correction scope.
admin_reject_hint: Rejecting records the verdict and closes the editorial task; the target record stays as it is.
admin_filing_applied: Correction applied - {n} field(s) rewritten on the record
admin_filing_rejected: Correction rejected - the record stands as it was
admin_drift_warning: n assertion(s) differ from the record's current values; the assertions were applied.
admin_decide_no_items: This filing has no field assertions to apply.
admin_items_override_hint: Edit proposed values before accepting. Only changed rows are written, and the change is recorded in the audit.
admin_apply_not_correctable: This record type cannot be changed through a correction; use the matching entry point.
admin_official_hint: Correct this record directly as the editorial office. It takes effect on submit and is recorded in the audit.
admin_official_audit_note: Submitting creates an official correction that takes effect immediately; if validation fails, it is marked rejected.
filing_applied_note: The editorial office accepted this correction; the target record has been updated.
filing_rejected_note: The editorial office declined this correction; the target record was not changed.
protein_link_hint: An explicit assertion: this enzyme record describes the same molecule as that protein record.
protein_link_unbind_confirm: Remove the link to this protein record?
protein_picker_hint: Optional: pick the protein record this enzyme IS (the same molecule).
submit_genes_desc: Record a gene: its own asserted DNA and RNA letters, plus the regions that live on them.
gene_dna_sites_hint: Cut sites are found by scanning this record's DNA against the catalog's enzymes.
gene_unplaced_hint: Rows whose coordinates do not fit the declared sequence are marked unplaced.
gene_cds_protein_only_hint: A CDS region can name the protein it encodes.
gene_hint_dna_seq: DNA letters: ACGT, IUPAC ambiguity codes (R, Y, …) and N.
gene_hint_rna_seq: RNA letters: ACGU, IUPAC ambiguity codes and N.
gene_hint_one_model: One record = one transcript model; isoforms get their own records. Regions may stay open at either end.
gene_external_protein_hint: We will look up this protein record for you. An unbound CDS region is bound automatically; an existing binding opens directly.
genetic_code_hint: This table is shared by many species; bindings are listed below.
genetic_code_species_hint: Species explicitly bound to this table are listed here.
genetic_code_no_species: No species are bound to this table yet.
genetic_code_bind_hint: Enter its NCBI tax id; the scientific name is optional but recommended.
genetic_code_taxon_invalid: The NCBI tax id must be a positive integer.
gene_evidence_none: No feature source information on this row.
reaction_equation_hint: Click a compound to open its reagent record; missing ones are fetched from PubChem.
reaction_uniprotkb_count_hint: View imports the protein first, then opens its record.
reaction_enzymes_group_hint: Proteins sharing a name are grouped: {groups} names across {rows} records ({total} total).
reagent_identifiers_hint: CAS, EC, UNII, ChEMBL and similar registry numbers; entries with a source link open directly.
enzyme_brenda_empty: No species functional data for this EC number yet.
enzyme_brenda_need_ec: This enzyme has no EC number, so BRENDA data cannot be linked yet.
enzyme_brenda_fetch_hint: Fetches the public BRENDA page for this EC number and stores its per-organism assertions. Contributors share the result.
catalog_empty_tab: Nothing here yet. Check back later.
gene_refresh_hint: Select the new values to apply; unselected fields stay as they are. Manually maintained fields are locked by default, and conflicts where both local and source values changed stay unchecked.
gene_refresh_no_base: Sync once to establish a baseline before comparing local edits.
evidence_chain_rna_missing: No RNA sequence asserted on this record.
evidence_chain_cds_missing: No CDS region asserted on this record.
evidence_chain_protein_missing: No protein linked to a CDS region.
chain_continue_hint: Continue on the protein page to see sequence, structure and validation.
protein_structure_candidates_hint: These chains share a UniProt accession with this sequence but not identical letters (initiator Met, signal peptide or isoform). A human decision is needed.
protein_candidate_primary_hint: Observed data from a confirmed candidate structure.
protein_mutation_map_structure_hint: In structure means an exact-match PDB entity exists, so residue numbering is 1:1. Residue mapping uses exact-match PDB entities.
evidence_chain_hint: Related records linked by public ID.
chain_gene_missing: No gene region names this protein
chain_gene_candidate: Matched by gene symbol and organism; the CDS is not linked yet
chain_rna_candidate: Open the gene record to link its CDS to this protein
chain_fold_missing: No fold or validation rows loaded
cw_intro: Re-code a protein or CDS with the synonymous codons a published usage table prefers. Every choice is deterministic; ties go to the alphabetically first codon.
cw_mode_hint_protein: Enter one-letter amino acids. A terminal * is optional — a stop codon is appended when it is missing.
cw_mode_hint_dna: Enter a coding sequence in DNA or RNA spelling. Its translation and original codons are kept for comparison.
cw_dataset_empty: No codon usage snapshots are available.
cw_dataset_no_map: This snapshot has no codon map for the selected species.
cw_code_fallback_none: This snapshot names no genetic code; NCBI table 1 is used.
cw_code_fallback_missing: The snapshot's genetic code could not be loaded; NCBI table 1 is used.
cw_code_standard_fallback: This taxon inherits the standard genetic code (NCBI 1).
cw_taxon_hint: Look up the genetic code for an NCBI taxon id, then match it to a codon usage snapshot in the list.
cw_taxon_invalid: Enter a positive NCBI taxon id (digits only).
cw_taxon_none: No codon usage snapshot matches taxon {id}.
cw_taxon_empty: The snapshot matched taxon {id} but carries no codon map for it.
cw_copy_fail: Clipboard unavailable; the sequence can still be selected manually.
cw_no_before_dna: Protein input has no before DNA; the optimized sequence is shown above.
cw_no_before_short: No before value for protein input
cw_table_codons_hint: Highlighted rows changed codon; the amino acid is unchanged.
cw_table_choices_hint: One deterministic choice per amino acid, using the selected dataset's highest-frequency synonymous codon.
cw_warn_empty: Enter a protein or DNA sequence first.
cw_warn_length: The sequence length ({n} nt) is not a multiple of 3.
cw_warn_alphabet: Non-nucleotide letter(s): {letters}. Use A, C, G, T or U.
cw_warn_unknown_codon: Codon(s) not in this genetic code: {list}.
cw_warn_no_codon: This genetic code has no codon for {aa}.
cw_warn_no_stop: This genetic code has no stop codon to append.
cw_warn_internal_stop: An internal stop codon appears before the end of the protein.
cw_warn_missing_usage: {n} chosen codon(s) have no usage entry in this dataset.
cw_warn_appended_stop: A terminal stop codon was added automatically.
cw_warn_no_dataset: Choose a codon usage dataset before optimizing.
cw_nav_desc: Re-code a protein or CDS with a published codon usage table.
pdb_entities_hint: Expand an entity to see its source sequence, components and linked records.
pdb_entity_no_sequence: This entity carries no polymer sequence.
pdb_viewer_hint: Coordinates are rendered by Mol*; chain sequences keep the source text.
pdb_viewer_missing: This entry has no coordinates to render yet.
protein_candidate_pending_hint: Shares a UniProt accession; waiting for human confirmation.
sequence_stability_domain_hint: The pH × temperature × ionic-strength stability space produced by the SPICE engine.
sequence_stability_domain_none: No SPICE-engine stability scan for this sequence yet.
relations_empty: No relations recorded for this entity.
extid_empty: No external identifiers recorded for this entity.
extid_import_note: Automatically imported from an external catalog.
enzyme_catalog_search_brenda: Search BRENDA by name or EC number and import the entry you need
enzyme_overview_brenda_hint: Substrates, optima and kinetic values are recorded per organism — open the species functional data tab
feature_label_intro: A global label vocabulary you can export. Adding, renaming and retiring labels requires the Researcher role and is recorded in the audit.
feature_label_retire_confirm: Retire {key}? Existing records keep the key; new records will not use it.
feature_label_read_only: Changing labels requires the Researcher role; this account can view and export.
feature_label_description_placeholder: What kind of feature does this label describe?
feature_label_key_immutable: Scope and key identify the label and are fixed after creation. To use a different key, create a new label and retire the old one.
pathway_steps_spd_hint: Imported topology reactions are listed below. Bind a reaction ID to each row, or add a row. Changes are reviewed by the editorial office.
pathway_steps_bind_hint: Enter a Reaction ID, then blur or press Enter
pathway_steps_bind_required: Bind at least one reaction before submitting.
pathway_steps_unbound_note: Bind a row to include it as a step.
pathway_steps_drag_hint: Drag a row to reorder; the list order is the step order.
pathway_steps_filed: Step change submitted for editorial review
pathway_steps_research_note: Researchers can propose step changes; the editorial office applies them after review.
pathway_steps_duplicate: That reaction is already in the step list.
feature_write_requires_researcher: You can view these features; adding or binding requires the Researcher role.
protein_feature_hint: Coordinates use canonical sequence numbering. If the source gives no position, leave it blank.
supplementary_zip_hint: Pack raw records, images or analysis files into one .zip; public download opens after review.
supplementary_zip_invalid: That file is not a valid .zip archive.
